structured.answer: I haven't decided and I'll ask my son first. The page says to hold it at "פסגות" (which I never heard of) and buy "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125" (5112628). With their 10,000 ₪ to start and 500 ₪ a month, that leaves about 86,045 ₪ after 10 years, if their 7% a year holds. At Leumi or Hapoalim it would be about 81,000–83,000 ₪.
